column1: api_name (required, unique; the name your game passes to the API)
column2: setid (optional; the id of a set that already exists)
column6: progress_stat_name (optional; the name of a stat that already exists, blank for no progress bar)
column7: progress_stat_min (number, no lower than the stat's own min)
column8: progress_stat_max (number, above min and no higher than the stat's own max)
